goal: To fine-tune YOLO on user-specific scenes by implementing a multi-stage auto-training pipeline, including scene model integration, false positive suppression, data collection, evaluation, dataset export, and gated model promotion with rollback capabilities.
constraints: Task must be decomposed chapter-by-chapter into ATOMS (1 file / small change / passes its own tests).
All new/modified code must pass `pytest` in `bridge-projects/oko`.
Architect (Claude) must review atoms of each chapter.
VLM-gate suppression requires 2-5 minutes warmup before activation.
YOLO model promotion is ONLY allowed if it outperforms the current model on the held-out evaluation set.
Automatic rollback mechanism must be implemented to store and restore old weights.
A single Telegram confirmation must be sent upon successful model promotion.
